Exported Types

group Mesh_Network_Exported_Types
struct net_pkt_t

Mesh network packet format.

Public Members

uint8_t nid

Least significant 7 bits of network identity.

uint8_t ivi

Least significant bit of initialization vector index.

uint8_t ttl

Time to live; indicates the remaining lifespan of the packet.

uint8_t ctl

Network Control for NetMIC size and msg type (Access/Control msg indicator).

uint8_t seq[3]

Sequence number for the packet.

uint16_t src

Source address from which the packet originated.

uint16_t dst

Destination address to which the packet is intended.

uint8_t trans_payload[16 + 4]

Transmission payload with a varying length from 1 to 16 bytes, followed by a 4 or 8 byte Network Message Integrity Check (NetMIC).
